design.prompt_policy: Send identical prompt text to each system. System-specific parameter settings, model identity, exact prompt bytes and output SHA-256 must be recorded.
design.review_policy: AfroCuban, BossaNova and Flamenco prompts are candidate evaluation instructions only. A knowledgeable practitioner review is required before authenticity claims or any culture-specific promotion.
